note: Models whose glTF occlusion channel is near-black where the mesh samples it: Godot draws baked occlusion, Blender does not, so these show black patches in the game and only in the game. Measured by tools/visual_review/ao_check.py, collected by tools/asset_pipeline/cairnwold/ao_flag_report.py. ArtLibrary enables AOEnabled on every model that HAS an occlusion map and is NOT named here; before this list existed it set AOEnabled = false on every model, which threw the occlusion away on all of them. Cairnwold: 0 of its 70 ready models are flagged, so all of them now draw the occlusion they were built with. The shared depot: 479 of 572 are flagged and keep the old behaviour.
